Test: TC-4194 — Feature area - Box - Creating - Creating timeboxes inside on Scope Definition - Date validation
Priority: Medium | Status: In Review | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/TS-87 Feature area - Box - Creating
Labels: team#Enigma

Description:
This Test Case works when BigPicture Enterprise is disabled, as Enterprise by default suggests different timeboxes to be created inside.

Steps:
1. Navigate to Scope Definition of boxName.
   Data: boxName: TC-4194 Feature area - Box - Creating - Creating timeboxes inside on Scope Definition - Date validation
   Expected: Scope definition tab is displayed. The folLowing fields are visible:

* Project
* Board
* Filter
* Narrow down
* Advanced configuration (With collapsed chevron)


Underneath the Automatic Rules, a Timeboxes section is visible with TC-4194 PI sub-scope synchronization settings.
2. Click on the arrow down adjacent to boxName in Timeboxes section.
   Data: boxName: TC-4194 PI
   Expected: The folLowing message is displayed in a dropdown: "TC-4194 PI has no timeboxes. Do you want to create Iteration inside?"

Create and Cancel buttons are visible underneath.
3. Click the Create button.
   Expected: Modal window appears with header: 'Create timeboxes' and text: 'Period time of "TC-4194 PI": 2023-05-08 - 2023-05-11.'

There are three fields:
Name: 'Iteration'
Start date - End Date: 
'08/May/23'
'21/May/22'

+Add more button is visible under Name field on the left side of the modal. 

In the Lower right corner there are two buttons: 

* Cancel (active)
* Create (active)
4. Set endDate of Iteration by clicking on third column in first row.
   Data: endDate: 09/May/23
   Expected: Calendar closes. End date field has 09/May/23 value. Create button is active with blue color.
5. Click the +Add more button.
   Expected: Two rows are visible inside of the modal with three fields. In the first row the folLowing data is visible:
Name: 'Iteration'
Start date - End Date: 
'08/May/23'
'09/May/22'

In the second row the folLowing data is visible:
Name: 'Iteration 2'
Start date - End date: 
'10/May/23'
'11/May/23'

An +Add more button is visible under Name field on the left side of the modal.

In the Lower right corner there are two buttons:

* Cancel (active)
* Create (active)
6. Click the +Add more button again.
   Expected: Three rows are visible inside of the modal with three fields. In the first row the folLowing data is visible:
Name: 'Iteration'
Start date - End Date: 
'08/May/23'
'09/May/22'

In the second row the folLowing data is visible:
Name: 'Iteration 2'
Start date - End date: 
'10/May/23'
'11/May/23'

In the third row the folLowing data is visible:
Name: 'Iteration 3'
Start date - End date: 
'12/May/23'
'13/May/23'

An +Add more button is visible under Name field on the left side of the modal.

In the Lower right corner there are two buttons:

* Cancel (active)
* Create (active)
7. Click the Create button.
   Expected: The folLowing error appears: "Iteration 3 period must fit within the TC-4194 PI period". No Iteration is created.
8. Set endDate of Iteration 2 by clicking on third column in second row.
   Data: endDate: 12/May/23
   Expected: Iteration 2 has the folLowing dates:
Start Date: 10/May/23
End Date: 12/May/23

The folLowing errors appear:

"Box Iteration 2 overlaps with others"
"Box Iteration 3 overlaps with others"

Create button is not active.
9. Set startDate and endDate of Iteration 3 by clicking on second and third column in third row.
   Data: startDate: 13/May/23
endDate: 14/May/23
   Expected: Iteration 3 has the folLowing dates:
Start Date: 13/May/23
End Date: 14/May/23

There are no error messages. The create button is active.
10. Click the Create button.
   Expected: The folLowing error messages appear:
"Iteration 2 period must fit within the TC-4194 PI period"
"Iteration 3 period must fit within the TC-4194 PI period"

Create button is not active.
11. Click on the bin button beside Iteration 3.
   Expected: Iteration 3 is no longer visible inside the Create timeboxes modal.
12. Set endDate of Iteration 2 by clicking on the third column in second row.
   Data: endDate: 11/May/23
   Expected: Iteration 2 has the folLowing dates:
Start Date: 10/May/23
End Date: 11/May/23
13. Click the Create button.
   Expected: Iteration and Iteration 2 are created under TC-4194 PI successfully.
